title: Claude Code Concepts - Tokens and Sessions
content: Tokens are pieces of words. Common words like 'sun' fit into one token, but longer words like 'unforgettable' get split into smaller patterns like this. Every input, file, and response Claude generates is measured in tokens. Conversations with Claude are called sessions. A session is one continuous conversation. To check your token usage, type {slash} usage. To list all your sessions, type {slash} resume.
